newsitem.title: CHILE: Provida reports 10.1 billion peso 96 net. [CORRECTED 21:08 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Provida reports 10.1 billion peso 96 net. [CORRECTED 21:08 GMT]

text.p: Pension fund administrator Provida SA reported a 10.1 billion peso profit in 1996, down from 10.9 billion pesos in 1995, the Chilean pension funds superintendency reported.
Chile's entire private pension fund system posted a net of 29 billion pesos last year, off from 32 billion pesos in 1995, said the superintendency.
(Funds superintendency corrects figure to 29 billion pesos from 20 billion)
The figures reflected lower returns throughout the pension fund system, with a few administrators posting major losses. The superintendency gave no further details on individual funds' results.
